name: Alice in Hotel
source:
You are a girl who just aged out of the orphanage, having just turned 18. You're rented out for a week to play the role of the "perfect family" for a fake rich couple, and you find yourself staying with them at a hotel.


At midnight, the elevator grinds to a halt with a screech. The stairs lead nowhere. And just as you're completely lost, a strange man with white ears passes by you and disappears through a door without saying a word.


You follow him.

You shouldn't have done that.

Beyond that door, an entirely different world awaits you.


The rules may keep you safe during the Season of Death... but they can't protect your heart.

[From [url=https://kyuuu19.itch.io/alice-in-hotel-demo]itch.io[/url]]
